EvidenceNeed.description: A piece of evidence the run still needs, with its resolution status.

acceptable_source_kinds.description: Source kinds the requester would accept for this need; empty means any (not yet used to filter sources).
acceptable_source_kinds.title: Acceptable Source Kinds

category.description: Which kind of evidence would satisfy the need.

id.description: Stable id of the need; answers and coverage are keyed by it.
id.title: Id

priority.description: Whether the need blocks resolution (required) or only improves it (supporting).

question.description: What the evidence must tell the run.
question.title: Question

resolution.description: Notes on how the need was resolved, such as why no source could serve it.
resolution.title: Resolution

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

status.description: Whether the need is open, satisfied, partly met or cannot be met.

EvidenceNeed.title: EvidenceNeed

RetrievalLimits.description: Result limits for one retrieval request.

max_chars.description: Most characters of evidence to return in total; null uses the configured default.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

top_k.description: Most evidence items to return; null uses the configured default.
top_k.title: Top K

RetrievalLimits.title: RetrievalLimits

RetrievalNeedsOutput.description: Host interpretation, never a retrieved answer or approval of a classifier.

completeness.description: Whether the question wants one entity, chosen entities, a full set, a count, or just examples.
completeness.title: Completeness

detail_mode.description: How much of each selected item the question needs: requested fields, the whole document, or bounded surroundings.
detail_mode.title: Detail Mode

engine.description: Which interpreter produced the output; always the host language model.
engine.title: Engine

hierarchy_levels.description: Explicit hierarchy level filter; empty means all levels, never an inferred level restriction.
hierarchy_levels.title: Hierarchy Levels

hierarchy_scope.description: Whether a population answer includes or excludes the chosen root and its parents.
hierarchy_scope.title: Hierarchy Scope

model_id.description: Model that produced the interpretation, when known; reported usage is authoritative.
model_id.title: Model Id

original_question.description: The question echoed back unchanged, so the output can be matched to its request.
original_question.title: Original Question

rationale.description: Brief reason for the interpretation, for human review.
rationale.title: Rationale

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

scope_resolution.description: Whether retrieval may start, needs discovery first, or lacks a user choice.
scope_resolution.title: Scope Resolution

selections.description: For each dimension, the offered labels the host judges the question needs.
selections.title: Selections

source_scope.description: The request's source scope echoed back unchanged; the host may not widen it.
source_scope.title: Source Scope

status.description: Whether the interpretation is usable (decided) or needs resolution before retrieval.
status.title: Status

uncertain.description: For each dimension, the offered labels the host could not decide on.
uncertain.title: Uncertain

unresolved.description: Meanings the catalog could not express, unknowns and contradictions, left for resolution.
unresolved.title: Unresolved

RetrievalNeedsOutput.title: RetrievalNeedsOutput

answer_requirements.description: Preserved across research, clarification and progressive source disclosure.
answer_requirements.title: Answer Requirements

assessment.description: Scoped supplied evidence interpreted conditionally by the neutral retrieval port.
assessment.title: Assessment

detail.description: How much of each hit to return: an excerpt, a summary, or its locator only.
detail.title: Detail

explicit_locators.description: Exact places to fetch before ranking: `path`, `path#Lx-Ly`, `path#heading`, `path::Symbol`.
explicit_locators.title: Explicit Locators

jev_reserve.description: Jev calls retained for the requester; graph planning must not spend this reserve.
jev_reserve.title: Jev Reserve

knowledge.description: Neutral knowledge request fields, fully validated by the capability adapter.
knowledge.title: Knowledge

limits.description: Bounds on how much evidence the request may return.

max_rerank_batches.description: Most rerank batches this request may judge (the requester's Jev budget affords no more than this beside its reserve); null means the configured `retrieval.rerank_max_batches`.
max_rerank_batches.title: Max Rerank Batches

need.description: The evidence need to retrieve for; its question and category steer the search.

query_hints.description: Texts to search for before the need's own wording: the goal first, then criteria, options.
query_hints.title: Query Hints

retrieval_needs.description: Accepted interpretation of the original question, retained across retrieval and catalog selection.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

source_ids.description: Sources to search; empty means every eligible source.
source_ids.title: Source Ids
